output_list.criticism: The function setBettingCondition takes two parameters _contenders and _bettingprice. If _contenders is greater than 1000, it will cause an integer overflow. This can lead to incorrect results and potentially loss of funds.
The function getBettingPrice returns the betting price, which is set to 1 ether in the constructor. If the betting price is modified, it may cause an integer overflow.
The function getDeveloperFee divides the balance by 100, which may cause an integer division by zero if the balance is less than 100 wei.
The function getLotteryMoney calculates the prize as the balance minus the developer fee. If the developer fee is zero, this may cause an integer division by zero.
The function getBettingStatus returns the developer fee as the balance divided by 100. If the balance is less than 100 wei, this may cause an integer division by zero.
